## Summary

I implemented **F006 (versioned local guide artifact)** for plan `2026-06-03-001`. The new module `scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/agent_guide.py` renders a version-stamped (`GUIDE_VERSION` + runtime + brief-generator version) DontPanic operating guide that is *generated* — never a second hand-maintained manual: it embeds the live operating brief verbatim (role distinction, supported commands, canonical workflow) and projects the F002 command-guidance inventory into COMMAND CLASSES, one-SAFE-EXAMPLE-per-class, and a LOCAL DECISION HANDOFF section, plus a new canonical `NO_INTER_FEATURE_PROMPT_POLICY` ("do not ask between features unless DontPanic requires human input"). It's exposed through the existing agent surface as `dontpanic agent guide` (prints), `--path` (prints the `<dontpanic_home>/agent-guide.md` locator), and `--write` (materializes it); I also added a public `command_class_label()` helper to `command_guidance.py`, pointed the root-help "Start here" snippet at the guide locator, and updated the `agent`/usage listings. The 15-test TDD suite (`test_f006_agent_guide.py`) proves guide existence, version-stamping, deterministic rendering, every required policy/section, brief+inventory parity (rendered examples must be real inventory argv; the guide changes when the inventory grows), t

commands_run: PYTHONPATH=scripts python -m dontpanic_orchestrate agent guide --write   # (DONTPANIC_HOME=<tmpdir>, smoke test only)
